release-item.p: Fix reporting of OpenSSL errors.

An error queued by the OpenSSL config or left over from an earlier failure could be reported instead of the actual failure, e.g. ssl command section not found for an invalid tls-cipher-12 value. System errors such as a missing CA file reported no details available with OpenSSL >= 3.0 and now report the system error message.
Do not lower a minimum TLS version set by the OpenSSL config.

The minimum TLS version was set to 1.2 after the OpenSSL config was applied. This lowered a higher minimum such as MinProtocol = TLSv1.3 so TLS 1.2 connections were still allowed. The minimum is now set only when the minimum from the config is lower than TLS 1.2.
Fix possible block incremental restore failure on SFTP storage.

Each super block read left a file open on the server until the session ended. A restore could reach the open file limit of the server and fail with an error such as sftp errno [4] or client state is 'response' but expected 'idle'. Super block reads are now closed before they are freed.
Fix use of SFTP file handles after a reconnect.

A reconnect freed the session while other files could still be open on it and the next read or write of one of those files used freed memory. These now fail with connection was lost, which allows the job to be retried.
Fix page checksum validation for non-default relation segment sizes.

can be built with a relation segment size other than 1GB, e.g. --with-segsize=2. Page checksums were validated for a 1GB segment so pages in every segment after the first were reported as invalid and corruption past the first 1GB of a larger segment was not reported. The segment size is now read from pg_control.

Backups of these clusters taken with earlier versions may contain false page checksum errors, which cause the restore command to fail and the expire command to refuse to expire. Set checksum-page-error=n for these backups. Differential and incremental backups keep the errors for unchanged files until the next full backup.
Fix io-timeout for SFTP storage while server keepalives are arriving.

Each wait for the server restarted the timeout and any packet from the server ended the wait. When the server stopped responding but still sent keepalives more often than io-timeout an operation such as a file write or remove could wait indefinitely. The timeout now limits how long an operation can wait without making progress. A directory read that timed out or failed ended the list without an error and now reports the error.
Fix annotate saving backup.info to the default repository.

When repo was not specified, the annotate command searched each repository for the backup set but saved the updated backup.info to the default repository. Annotating a backup set that was not in the default repository replaced the backup.info of the default repository with the backup.info of the repository where the backup set was found. If the default repository was encrypted, the key required to read its backups was lost, so those backups could no longer be restored.

commit.subject: Redact the backup passphrase from history and restored manifests.
Index the base64 and hex decode tables with unsigned bytes.
Require a generated repository passphrase for new format 6 stanzas.
Generate a manifest key for each backup set in repository format 6.
Move stanza passphrase checks to stanzaCipherPassCheck().
Load archive.info and backup.info through infoLoadFile().
Add a minimum repository format for options.

release-item.p: Repository encryption key rotation.
Add tls-min-version option.

Set tls-min-version=1.3 to allow only TLS 1.3, e.g. for compliance. The default is 1.2. A higher minimum set in the OpenSSL config is not lowered. The option is ignored for repository storage connections when repo-storage-verify-tls=n.
Improve errors for an info file or manifest that cannot be loaded.

A file decrypted with the wrong repo-cipher-pass was reported with the random bytes it decrypted to, once for the file and again for its copy. A line that is not text is now shown as <binary data> and an error that repeats for the copy is reported once.
Reconnect SFTP storage after an open times out.

An SFTP server can stop responding on a session while the connection stays up. An open on that session failed with libssh2 error [-9] or libssh2 error [-37] and each retry used the same session and failed the same way. The session is now reopened and the open is retried once.
Reconnect SFTP storage after a failed send during open.

An SFTP server with ClientAliveInterval set drops a session that does not respond to keepalives, e.g. the session of the main process during the copy phase of a backup. The next open on that session failed with libssh2 error [-7]. The session is now reopened and the open is retried once.

commit.subject: Add OpenSSF Security Insights file and security CI checks.

release-item.p: Add a security policy.

SECURITY.md describes how to report vulnerabilities privately using GitHub private vulnerability reporting or security@pgbackrest.org. The OpenSSF Security Insights file describes the project administrators, the release process, and the security tools run in CI and before release.
Prevent the SFTP unit test from modifying ~/.ssh/known_hosts.
The test created and removed ~/.ssh/known_hosts so running it outside a container deleted the file of the current user. The test now uses a home directory in the test path.
